cards.example_en: I am tired of the same lunch every day.
cards.example_zh: 我厌烦每天吃同样的午饭。

cards.example_en: I am used to getting up early.
cards.example_zh: 我习惯于早起。

cards.example_en: A map is useful to visitors.
cards.example_zh: 地图对游客有用。

cards.example_en: He is weak in spelling.
cards.example_zh: 他在拼写方面弱。

cards.example_en: Are you willing to share your notes?
cards.example_zh: 你愿意分享笔记吗？

cards.example_en: Parents are worried about the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 家长为这场大雨担心。

cards.example_en: Can you account for the missing ticket?
cards.example_zh: 你能解释这张票为什么不见了吗？

cards.example_en: They accuse him of copying the essay.
cards.example_zh: 他们指责他抄作文。

cards.example_en: We should act on the coach's advice.
cards.example_zh: 我们应按教练的建议行事。

cards.example_en: New students soon adapt to the timetable.
cards.example_zh: 新生很快适应课程表。

cards.example_en: Her joke will add to the fun of the party.
cards.example_zh: 她的笑话会给聚会增添乐趣。

cards.example_en: The prices add up to forty yuan.
cards.example_zh: 这些价格合计达四十元。

cards.example_en: Please adhere to the lab safety rules.
cards.example_zh: 请遵守实验室安全规则。

cards.example_en: We agree to the class plan.
cards.example_zh: 我们同意这个班级计划。

cards.example_en: I agree with you on this point.
cards.example_zh: 在这一点上我同意你。

cards.example_en: She finished ahead of the others.
cards.example_zh: 她比其他人先完成。

cards.example_en: The course will aim at clearer writing.
cards.example_zh: 这门课将旨在把文章写得更清楚。

cards.example_en: We aim for a calmer reading habit.
cards.example_zh: 我们力求养成更安定的阅读习惯。

cards.example_en: The plan must allow for a late bus.
cards.example_zh: 计划必须把公交车晚点考虑进去。

cards.example_en: Bring a pen along with your notebook.
cards.example_zh: 带上笔，连同笔记本一起。

cards.example_en: The fees amount to two hundred yuan.
cards.example_zh: 费用合计为二百元。

cards.example_en: Apart from rain, the field trip went well.
cards.example_zh: 除了下雨，实地考察进行得很顺利。

cards.example_en: Short stories appeal to many readers.
cards.example_zh: 短篇故事吸引许多读者。

cards.example_en: She will apply for the city scholarship.
cards.example_zh: 她将申请那项市级奖学金。

cards.example_en: This rule does not apply to visitors.
cards.example_zh: 这条规则对参观者不适用。

cards.example_en: Her parents approve of the reading club.
cards.example_zh: 她父母赞同这个读书社。

cards.example_en: Do not argue with the driver.
cards.example_zh: 别和司机争论。

cards.example_en: We arrive at the gate at eight.
cards.example_zh: 我们八点到达门口。

cards.example_en: They arrive in Chengdu on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 他们星期五到达成都。

cards.example_en: She called to ask after her former teacher.
cards.example_zh: 她打电话问候起以前的老师。

cards.example_en: You can ask for help at the desk.
cards.example_zh: 你可以在服务台请求帮助。

cards.example_en: Please attach a photo to the form.
cards.example_zh: 请把一张照片附在表格上。

cards.example_en: The nurse will attend to the patient.
cards.example_zh: 护士会照料这位病人。

cards.example_en: They attribute the gain to daily practice.
cards.example_zh: 他们把进步归因于每天练习。

cards.example_en: You can bargain with the book seller.
cards.example_zh: 你可以和卖书的人讲价。

cards.example_en: They base the play on a school diary.
cards.example_zh: 他们以一本校园日记为底本编这部剧。

cards.example_en: I believe in steady practice.
cards.example_zh: 我相信持之以恒的练习。

cards.example_en: Does this red cap belong to Lucy?
cards.example_zh: 这顶红帽子属于露西吗？

cards.example_en: Students benefit from reading aloud.
cards.example_zh: 学生从朗读中获益。

cards.example_en: Do not blame her for the rain delay.
cards.example_zh: 不要因为下雨耽误而责备她。

cards.example_en: Some members may break away from the old club.
cards.example_zh: 有些成员可能会脱离原来的社团。

cards.example_en: Old buses may break down in the heat.
cards.example_zh: 旧公交车可能在高温中出故障。

cards.example_en: Do not break into the locked lab.
cards.example_zh: 不要闯入上锁的实验室。

cards.example_en: They may break off the talk at noon.
cards.example_zh: 他们可能在中午中断谈话。

cards.example_en: A fire can break out in a dry store.
cards.example_zh: 干燥的仓库里可能爆发火灾。

cards.example_en: The team hopes to break through this year.
cards.example_zh: 队伍希望今年实现突破。

cards.example_en: The meeting will break up at five.
cards.example_zh: 会议将在五点散会。
